Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a complex two-step enrichment: first proximity labeling via TurboID (biotin) to capture subcellular proteins, then chemical capping of cysteines with alkyne-probes (IAA/IPIAA) followed by click-chemistry biotinylation for peptide-level enrichment. Quantification is performed using isotopic pairs of the cysteine capping reagents (Light vs Heavy) at the MS1 level.
